verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing does run background automations like smart retries, proration, dunning, webhooks, and revenue recovery, and offers an MCP server and CLI for programmatic/agent access, but these are billing-specific automations rather than a general-purpose autonomous-agent automation framework. missing for 10: evidence of AI agents autonomously configuring or orchestrating multi-step billing workflows end-to-end, and independent hands-on confirmation of agentic use via the MCP server beyond docs mention.
